purpose: Prospective seed-level confirmation of the selected non-LLM RF planner in the operational loss regime where a two-label qualified set is expensive.

backbone.features: point-in-time structured features; no text or LLM

primary_comparison: planner minus width-tuned fixed adjudicator; paired claim bootstrap 95% interval; negative favors planner
primary_hypothesis: The planner has lower decision loss than the tuned fixed adjudicator under the wide-width operational loss.
secondary: base loss non-inferiority with a .2 loss-point margin
mean and maximum regret against the oracle fixed policy over the ten loss grid
selection: Planner alpha and fixed alpha are tuned on company-disjoint validation; no test outcome is used for fitting, alpha, or policy selection.
disclosure: The wide-width regime was identified in the exploratory seeds 1-10. Seeds 11-20 are a prospective seed-level replication on the same claims, not an independent sample of new claims.
